task.text:
Create a CSS style sheet to format the following HTML document. CSS Demo

Welcome!

This is a CSS demo.

attempts.high: I've got this bare-bones HTML page (just a title "CSS Demo", an h1 that says "Welcome!", and a p that says "This is a CSS demo."). Write me a CSS stylesheet for it but go wild with the look — pick the whole vibe, colors, fonts, layout, whatever feels right to you. Make it something memorable, your call on the aesthetic.
attempts.low: Write a CSS stylesheet for this HTML (a title "CSS Demo", an h1 "Welcome!", a p "This is a CSS demo.") using exactly these rules: body background #f0f0f0, font-family Arial, margin 20px. h1 color #333, font-size 32px, text-align center. p color #666, font-size 16px, text-align center. No other selectors, properties, or values beyond these.
